description: End-to-end Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) order-to-cash workflow, covering design, ordering, provisioning, lifecycle changes, incident handling, and billing alignment.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier of the customer or tenant

order_id.description: Identifier for a NaaS service order

quote_id.description: Identifier for a commercial quote derived from a design

design_id.description: Identifier for a network service design or intent

service_id.description: Identifier of a provisioned network service instance

change_request_id.description: Identifier for a requested change to an existing service

incident_id.description: Identifier of a service incident or fault ticket

billing_account_id.description: Identifier of the billing account associated with a customer

functions.name: design_network_service
functions.description: Create a high-level intent-based design for a NaaS service, including sites, connectivity, QoS, and security policies.

use_case.description: High-level use case for the service

sites.description: List of customer sites to be connected

site_ref.description: Logical reference name for the site

region_code.description: Cloud region or internal region code

security_policies.description: High-level security policies between sites or groups

inspection_profile.description: If action=inspect, which deep inspection profile to use

path_diversity.description: Prefer physically diverse network paths where possible

functions.returns: Created design_id, normalized design details, and feasibility flags.

functions.name: check_network_availability
functions.description: Validate technical and commercial availability for a given design, including per-site feasibility and alternative options.

design_id.description: Identifier of the design to evaluate

include_alternatives.description: Whether to propose alternate access types, regions, or bandwidths when primary is unavailable

functions.returns: Availability report with per-site feasibility, SLA viability, and list of alternative options if needed.

functions.name: generate_naas_quote
functions.description: Create a commercial quote based on a validated design and availability check, including itemized charges and discounts.

design_id.description: Reference to the design to be quoted

billing_account_id.description: Billing account to be used for pricing rules and taxes

commercial_overrides.description: Optional commercial overrides and negotiation parameters

discounts.description: List of discount rules to apply

target_ref.description: Reference to site or component if scope is not 'total'

reason_code.description: Internal reason code for the discount

validity_days.description: Number of days the quote remains valid

include_tax_breakdown.description: Whether to compute and show tax/VAT breakdown

functions.returns: quote_id with full commercial breakdown, term, taxes, and total recurring/non-recurring charges.

functions.name: create_naas_order
functions.description: Convert an accepted quote or design into an executable NaaS order, including service decomposition and initial workflow state.

quote_id.description: Accepted quote to be converted to an order

design_id.description: If no quote_id, create order directly from design; may trigger auto-pricing

order_reference.description: Customer-side purchase order or reference number

requested_start_date.description: Requested service activation date and time

fulfillment_preferences.description: Preferences related to rollout and scheduling

attachments.description: Optional documents such as LOAs, site access letters, etc.

functions.returns: order_id with initial status, decomposed line items, and projected milestones.

functions.name: get_naas_order
functions.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific NaaS order, including status, line items, and related entities.

include.description: Optional expansions to include in the response

functions.returns: Order details including current status, timelines, associated design/quote, and optionally related artifacts.

functions.name: list_naas_orders
functions.description: List and filter NaaS orders for a customer or globally, with pagination and sorting.
functions.returns: Paginated list of orders matching the filters, including basic summaries and navigation cursors.

functions.name: start_service_provisioning
functions.description: Trigger or resume technical provisioning workflow for an order, orchestrating underlying network controllers and vendors.

site_refs.description: If scope=specific_sites, limit provisioning to these site references

line_item_ids.description: If scope=specific_line_items, limit to these order line items

force_recheck_availability.description: Re-run availability checks before provisioning if earlier checks are outdated

dry_run.description: If true, simulate provisioning and return an impact report without executing changes

functions.returns: Provisioning job identifier, updated order status, and initial task breakdown with estimated timelines.

functions.name: get_service_status
functions.description: Retrieve operational status and KPIs for a provisioned NaaS service instance or service instances under an order.

order_id.description: If service_id not provided, fetch status for all services under this order

time_window.description: Optional time range for KPI aggregation

functions.returns: Service operational status, per-site health, KPIs and SLA metrics, and any active incidents.

functions.name: request_service_change
functions.description: Submit a change request for an existing NaaS service, such as bandwidth upgrade, topology change, or policy update.

requested_effective_date.description: Requested effective date/time for the change

items.description: Policy names or IDs to remove

early_termination_acknowledged.description: Customer acknowledges any early termination charges

functions.returns: change_request_id with initial validation status, required approvals, and estimated impact on billing and SLA.

functions.name: retry_or_rollback_provisioning
functions.description: Retry failed provisioning steps or perform a controlled rollback to the last stable state for an order or service.

service_id.description: Optional specific service instance to target

failure_context.description: Optional failure context to guide retry strategy

dry_run.description: If true, simulate the retry/rollback and show impact only

functions.returns: Updated provisioning job state, rollback markers if applicable, and audit trail entry.

functions.name: cancel_naas_order_or_service
functions.description: Cancel an in-progress order or terminate an active service with appropriate validations and billing implications.

service_id.description: If provided, cancel/terminate this specific service under the order or globally

acknowledge_charges.description: Customer acknowledgement of any cancellation or early termination charges

effective_date.description: Requested effective cancellation date; immediate if omitted or in the past

functions.returns: Cancellation confirmation with updated order/service status and summary of financial and operational impact.

functions.name: open_naas_incident
functions.description: Create an incident linked to a NaaS service or order, including impact details and initial diagnostics context.

order_id.description: Related order if the issue is during provisioning

attachments.description: Optional diagnostic artifacts like logs and screenshots

functions.returns: incident_id with initial triage status, SLA clock start time, and next actions.

functions.name: sync_billing_with_service_state
functions.description: Reconcile billing records with actual NaaS service state for an order, including proration and charge adjustments.

reconciliation_options.description: Advanced options to control reconciliation behavior

dry_run.description: If true, show proposed adjustments without posting them to billing

functions.returns: Reconciliation report with list of adjustments, proration details, and optionally posted billing events.

functions.name: search_naas_orders
functions.description: Faceted search across NaaS orders with rich filters, time windows, pagination, and aggregations.

facets.description: Facets to compute alongside the result set.

projection.description: Fields to include in the result objects.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A page of NaaS order summaries with facet aggregations, pagination cursor, and optional scoring metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_naas_orders
functions.description: Create multiple NaaS orders in a single atomic or best-effort batch with idempotency and partial-commit options.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A bulk-job descriptor with per-item outcomes, created NaaS order ids, error reasons for failures, and an aggregate counts summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_naas_orders
functions.description: Apply patch-style updates to many NaaS orders with optimistic concurrency and partial-failure handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-item update outcomes (success/failure with reason), new versions for each NaaS order, and a summary of skipped and quarantined items.

functions.name: bulk_archive_naas_orders
functions.description: Archive or soft-delete many NaaS orders in one call with retention, audit reason, and webhook notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id outcome, new lifecycle state for each NaaS order, scheduled purge date if applicable, and a job id for tracking.

functions.name: export_naas_orders
functions.description: Export NaaS order datasets to an external sink in CSV, JSON, Parquet, or NDJSON with filters and signed-URL delivery.

split_by.description: Field to shard output by, e.g., tenant_id.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with job id, estimated row count, signed-URL(s) when applicable, and asynchronous completion event details.

functions.name: import_naas_orders
functions.description: Bulk-import NaaS order records from a file or staging table with schema mapping, validation, and quarantine handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An import job descriptor with counts of valid, invalid, and quarantined rows, sample error messages, and identifiers of created or updated NaaS orders.

functions.name: subscribe_to_naas_order_events
functions.description: Register a webhook or message-bus subscription to receive NaaS order lifecycle events with filtering and retry policy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created subscription record with id, secret rotation hint, active state, and an example test-event payload for the NaaS order.

functions.name: get_naas_order_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the immutable audit trail for a NaaS order, including who changed what, when, and from which channel.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A chronologically ordered list of audit entries for the NaaS order, each with actor, action, before/after diff, source, and optional evidence links.

functions.name: schedule_recurring_naas_order_job
functions.description: Create or update a recurring job for NaaS orders using cron, ISO interval, or calendar windows with backfill and concurrency controls.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated schedule descriptor with id, next run time, effective cron, and any backfill plan summary for the NaaS order action.

functions.name: simulate_naas_order_changes
functions.description: Preview the effect of a proposed change to a NaaS order without persisting, returning a diff and impact analysis.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A simulation report showing the resulting state of the NaaS order, a structured diff, policy-check verdicts, and a quantitative impact estimate (cost, latency, blast radius).

functions.name: request_naas_order_approval
functions.description: Create an approval workflow request for a NaaS order change, with multi-stage approvers, SLA, and evidence attachments.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An approval-request descriptor with id, current stage, list of pending approvers, SLA deadlines, and links to the NaaS order under change.

functions.name: decide_naas_order_approval
functions.description: Record an approver decision (approve, reject, request changes) on a pending NaaS order approval request.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

expected_stage.description: Optimistic concurrency check on the approval stage.

functions.returns: The updated approval-request state including new stage, list of completed and pending approvers, and any condition list applied to the NaaS order.

functions.name: add_naas_order_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment, mention, or note to a NaaS order for collaboration and case-management context.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted comment record with id, threading info, visibility, mention/notification fan-out summary for the NaaS order.

functions.name: upload_naas_order_attachment
functions.description: Upload or link a binary attachment (evidence, log bundle, screenshot, contract) to a NaaS order with scanning and retention.

inline_data.description: Base64 payload when kind is inline_base64.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created attachment record with id, scan verdicts, signed download URL, checksum, and link to the NaaS order.

functions.name: create_naas_order_snapshot
functions.description: Capture an immutable point-in-time snapshot of a NaaS order (state, configuration, dependencies) for audit or rollback.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A snapshot record with id, size, checksum, encryption metadata, and a reference to the NaaS order version captured.

functions.name: restore_naas_order_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a NaaS order from a snapshot with selectable scope, validation pre-checks, and notification on completion.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A restore-operation descriptor with operation id, pre-restore snapshot id, validation results, conflict resolutions applied, and final state of the NaaS order.

functions.name: get_naas_order_metrics
functions.description: Compute and return KPI/metrics aggregates for NaaS orders over a time window with grouping, filters, and percentiles.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A metrics result with aggregate values, percentiles, optional period-over-period deltas, sparkline series per group, and the NaaS order domain context.

functions.name: get_naas_order_dashboard
functions.description: Return a pre-composed dashboard view for NaaS orders combining KPIs, alerts, top offenders, and time series.

personalize_for.description: User id to personalize widgets for.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A dashboard payload with KPI tiles, time-series data, top offenders, active alerts, and personalization metadata for the NaaS order context.

functions.name: create_naas_order_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule applied to NaaS orders with versioning, scope, and rollout strategy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated policy record with id, version, rollout plan, scope, and an effective-evaluation summary against current NaaS orders.

functions.name: evaluate_naas_order_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a NaaS order in dry-run, returning per-rule verdicts and proposed actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-policy and per-rule verdicts with reasons, trace data, and a list of proposed (or applied, when apply_actions=true) actions against the NaaS order.

functions.name: get_naas_order_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the upstream and downstream dependency graph for a NaaS order including services, devices, tickets, and contracts.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A graph payload (nodes, edges, optional health and metrics) describing dependencies for the NaaS order, with depth and direction respected.

functions.name: link_naas_order_to_related
functions.description: Create or remove an association between a NaaS order and another business object (incident, ticket, contract, asset).

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The resulting association record (or removal confirmation) including direction, relation type, and a snapshot of the related-object summary for the NaaS order.

functions.name: assign_naas_order_owner
functions.description: Assign or reassign ownership/roles on a NaaS order with hand-off rules, watchers, and notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The updated assignment roster for the NaaS order with effective windows, hand-off receipts, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: tag_naas_orders
functions.description: Apply, remove, or replace tags and labels on one or more NaaS orders, with conflict resolution and audit.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id tag-application outcomes with final tag sets and counts of added/removed/skipped operations for each NaaS order.

functions.name: compare_naas_order_versions
functions.description: Produce a structured diff between two versions (or snapshots) of a NaaS order with semantic equivalence handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A diff document describing added, removed, and changed fields between the two versions of the NaaS order, with optional side-by-side rendering.

functions.name: configure_naas_order_retry_policy
functions.description: Configure default retry, backoff, and circuit-breaker policy applied to NaaS order operations and their downstream actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted retry/circuit-breaker policy with id, effective scope, and a summary of NaaS order operations that match the new policy.

functions.name: check_naas_order_health
functions.description: Run a synthetic health/probe sweep against a NaaS order and its critical dependencies and return aggregated health status.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Aggregated health verdict for the NaaS order, per-probe results, dependency roll-up, and any alert notifications dispatched.

functions.name: clone_naas_order
functions.description: Clone a NaaS order into a new instance with selective fields, optional rename, and link-back metadata.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The cloned NaaS order record with id, lineage link to the source, and a summary of fields reset, copied, or skipped.

functions.name: generate_naas_order_report
functions.description: Generate a formatted NaaS order report (executive, operational, compliance) and deliver via email/object storage.

schedule_id.description: When generated by a recurring schedule.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A report-generation receipt with report id, download URL or delivery confirmation, page/sheet count, and the NaaS order window covered.

functions.name: escalate_naas_order
functions.description: Escalate a NaaS order to a higher tier or owner group with reason, severity bump, and watcher fan-out.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The escalation record with new owner/tier, severity, SLA, watchers, and a log of notifications sent for the NaaS order.
